# foreman_katello_content_credential (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foreman_katello_content_credential" "rpm_gpg_key_centos7" {
  name    = "RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-7"
  content = file("${path.module}/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-7")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `content` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_katello_content_credential.rpm_gpg_key_centos7 <content_credential_id>
```
